name: town-world-expansion-v1
title: Town 世界元素扩展 v1
description: 在保留正式 Town 主构图的前提下，新增铁匠工坊、五栋可进入公共区的民宅、静态私人内屋边界、北侧山麓、南侧湖岸和环境查看交互，不引入工具升级、好感、采矿或钓鱼。
creator: fable
notes: Implemented foothills/lakeshore/blacksmith plus five independently enterable Town homes. Every home has a public living area, two distinct inspect hotspots, a visible collision-blocked private room with explanatory dialogue, and an exact return spawn; blacksmith entry moved to the red workshop yard. The expansion keeps 30 gatherable trees and adds no friendship, schedule, permission, save or database state. Town contract 5/5, typecheck and client build pass; offline TMJ rendering confirmed the public/private room layouts. Local browser access remains blocked by browser security policy, so the one remaining acceptance item is a short human route through the expanded world. Included in the requested consolidated Town-life version; task remains in_progress only for the short human route acceptance and later archival.
